items.title: RxSight (RXST) Stock Sees Fair Value Cut After Analysts Flag Execution Risks
items.summary: The average fair value estimate for RxSight has been cut from about US$7.57 to roughly US$6.10, a decline of around 19% that reflects a more cautious stance in current models. Recent analyst commentary links these lower price targets to execution risks, softer Q3 revenue of US$24.6m, and sector pressure in ophthalmology that is affecting confidence in earlier growth assumptions. items.title: Why Is Wells Fargo (WFC) Losing A $1.3 Billion Team While Bitcoin ETF Holdings Grow?
items.summary: Wells Fargo (NYSE:WFC) has lost a multigenerational financial advisor group overseeing about US$1.3b in client assets to &Partners. The departing wealth management team had been based at Wells Fargo and served clients across multiple generations within families. Separately, Wells Fargo has doubled client holdings in BlackRock's Bitcoin ETF while the wider bitcoin ETF market has seen outflows.
